name: quotengine-dental
description: Config-driven dental estimate engine with guarded multimodal intake, deterministic TypeScript pricing, privacy controls, and evaluation tooling

scripts.worker:validate:staging: npm run catalog:validate && node scripts/validate-worker-config.mjs staging
scripts.worker:validate:production: npm run catalog:validate && node scripts/validate-worker-config.mjs production
scripts.worker:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply LEADS_DB --remote --env production
scripts.worker:deploy:staging: npm run worker:validate:staging && npm run worker:migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env ""
scripts.worker:deploy:production: npm run worker:validate:production && npm run worker:migrate:production && wrangler deploy --env production
